findings.evidence: l2_check's `_unexecuted` reads `view.elements`, which keeps the first declaration across bundles (the core element). Where D-80 addendum (d) (item 103) moved `apv:NotDispatched` into an inference-bundle mention, the A3 class reports the parts as `unexecuted_missing`. The dispatch census matches exactly: head 679 (of 815; 136 stay core), agentdyn-a 1,800, rope 753, ast-survey-agentdojo 49; 2024-06 (153) and adprov (48) did not move. Cross-cutting: recorded once, here.
findings.recommendation: Future pre-checks: count `apv:dispatchStatus` in every bundle (post_check.py dispatch), or teach l2_check the inference-bundle mention; never read `unexecuted_missing` as a loss.
findings.title: l2_check's A3 `unexecuted` class reads only the core bundle
